overall_reason: A navy page with a tracked caps eyebrow, a numbered four-step card kit with identical 'Learn more' links and body copy that literally says the content does not matter; nothing names a roastery, a coffee or an action.

findings.evidence: Failed T-FIVE-SECOND: the h1 '每一杯，都有一段履历。' ('Every cup has a record') and the eyebrow 'ORIGIN · PROCESS · ROAST' imply coffee, but no brand, product, audience or action appears anywhere; the only links are four identical '了解更多 →' ('Learn more') with no destination.
findings.before: h1 '每一杯，都有一段履历。' + four '了解更多 →'
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: who roasts, what is sold, and the one action (buy, subscribe, visit)]; name it in the h1 or sub-line and give one primary link with a real href
findings.why: Visitor cannot tell what this is, who it is for or what to do.

findings.where: div.wrap > p and all four card paragraphs
findings.evidence: Card copy is self-describing filler: '第一张卡片里的说明文字，也写得足够长一些。' ('Explanatory text in the first card, also written long enough'), repeated with 二/三/四. The sweep caught the lede ('内容本身不重要', 'the content itself does not matter'); the four card bodies are the same residue and were not flagged.
findings.before: "第二张卡片里的说明文字，也写得足够长一些。"
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: what actually happens at each of origin, process and roast]; until supplied, remove the cards
findings.why: Placeholder copy shipped as content; nothing on the page is real.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-MIRROR: a 'how it works' 1-2-3(-4) step grid of equal rounded cards (14px radius, same soft shadow), each '0N / STEP N / two lines / Learn more →', is the stock section any brand in any category gets. The eyebrow promises three stages (Origin · Process · Roast) but the grid has four generic 'STEP' cards that name none of them.
findings.after: Name the stages in the headings themselves (origin, processing, roast, [DATA NEEDED: fourth stage or drop it]) and lay them as a sequence that reads as one process, not four equal tiles
findings.why: Numbered equal cards are a skeleton, not a story about this coffee.

findings.evidence: Failed T-LABEL-TRANSFORM and T-EYEBROW: '01' in Courier yellow and 'STEP ONE' in tracked caps say the same thing twice; covering either loses nothing. On a lang=zh page the English caps labels are costume, not content.
findings.after: One label, in the page's language and naming the stage, e.g. '产地' ([DATA NEEDED: confirm stage names]); drop the numeral or the word
findings.why: Double labels and borrowed English caps are template chrome.

findings.evidence: The h1 is declared in Impact, which has no CJK glyphs, so it renders in Noto Sans CJK SC (fonts.json); the em applies font-style: italic to Chinese, producing a synthetic oblique slant. The yellow italic 'one emphasised word' is the stock hero trick translated literally into a script that has no italic.
findings.before: h1 { font: 400 76px Impact } h1 em { font-style: italic; color: #ffd23f }
findings.after: Set the h1 in a real CJK display face; mark emphasis with weight or colour only (font-style: normal), or drop the emphasis
findings.why: Faux italics on Han characters read as an unexamined Latin default.

findings.evidence: The grid keeps repeat(3, 1fr) at phone width: cards are 88-99px wide with text columns 40-51px, so body text wraps every 2-3 characters across 11 lines and '了解更多 →' breaks over three lines (375 tiles 00-01). The fourth card orphans on its own row at both widths (LAY-137).
findings.after: @media (max-width: 640px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr } }; at desktop use 2x2 or 4 across for four items
findings.why: The layout was never looked at on a phone; sliver text and an orphan card are default-grid symptoms.

not_investigated: No strengths recorded: navy plus one yellow accent and the h1 line are the only decisions, and the yellow accent on navy is a stock pairing here, not argued
T-STOCK-ORDER: hero + 1-2-3 steps only (2 stock sections); short page, generated read rests on placeholder copy and default kit, not skeleton length
T-RIVAL-NAME: there is no brand name to swap; every line would hold for any coffee seller
Look family: dark-single-accent partially (navy ground L about 0.32, not below 0.20; one vivid yellow accent; mono numerals) so not counted as a cluster
copy voice: no contract or brand samples supplied
